dialogue.patient: I can't catch my breath — I couldn't even get up the stairs, doctor.
Since this morning. It's been building all day.
I've been coughing non-stop since last night.
When I breathe out there's a sound in my chest — the person next to me could hear it.
Three times this year I've been like this. Every time I've had to go to the clinic for an injection.
I've got the inhaler at home. I took two puffs and it hasn't helped.
My younger sister has asthma too. My mother's the same with the weather.
I'm more allergic than most people — dust, animal hair, flowers, all of it.
I live in the city. There's a lot of dust — the air's been terrible lately. I didn't think that mattered.
I haven't been abroad. I've been in Bangkok the whole time.
